# Brian Studwell

> Product designer. Designs human-in-the-loop agentic systems for high-stakes, regulated industries.

The work below was done at Ideagen, on its environment, health and safety (EHS) products and on Mazlan, Ideagen's AI.

## Work

- Groom Lake. Role: design lead. A down-to-the-studs redesign of the flagship EHS application, with an agent-first design system and overhauled core features. Results: deal loss related to UX reduced from 14% to 2%; NPS increased from -53 to +71; weekly active users increased from about 3,200 to about 11,000. Focus: platform redesign, design systems, pervasive AI.
- Blackbird. Role: design lead, 0-1. A new, unified mobile app for Ideagen's EHS portfolio, for workers in far-flung, dirty and dangerous places. Mazlan is embedded throughout to help users react and respond to their environment. Focus: agentic triage, product strategy, offline patterns.
- Mazlan Builder. Role: designer. An agentic configuration tool that puts self-serve customization in customers' hands. Result: benchmark tasks went from hours to minutes, without losing capability. Focus: AI UX, trust and safety, judgment gates.
- ADEPT and Workspace Personalization. Case studies in progress.

## How he works

Thinks in systems, keeps the plates spinning, and cares about the people who rely on his work. Prototypes in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with canvas, WebGL and three.js.
